local actions = addRow(parent, 64, 10)
local availH = math.max(220, h - top - 12)
ScaleMin = 0.75, -- UIScale = clamp(viewportY / 720, ScaleMin, ScaleMax)

findings.explanation: Estimate from the code: at UIScale 0.75 a 361-px-tall phone gives h ≈ 481 logical units and top ≈ 59-88 (gui inset + 8), so the window is about 380-410 tall. With the touch chrome (th = 59, contentTop = 79) the visible ScrollingFrame is only about 290-320 units. The Welcome content is padding 4 + portrait 170 + name (~30) + page (~20) + a 22-px wrapped line (~55-80) + status + a 64-unit action row + list padding, roughly 400-440 units. The 이전/다음/함께할게요 buttons start near y≈340 and are hidden until the player scrolls. This is the first required action of the first-play loop, and RELEASE_PLAN beta item 4 calls out phone layout. Desktop (scale 0.8, window up to 600) fits.
findings.failure_scenario: A phone player finishes choosing a class and the guide dialog opens. They see the portrait and text but no accept button, so they tap X (not acceptance) and the tutorial stays at step 0.
findings.suggested_fix: On short viewports, shrink the portrait (e.g. min(170, 0.3*content height)) or place it beside the text, and/or keep the action row outside the ScrollingFrame. Verify at 749x361 in Studio device emulation.
findings.verifier_note: My own arithmetic from the code agrees. Touch UIScale = clamp(361/720, 0.75, 1.25) = 0.75, so h ≈ 481. top = (inset 36-58 + 8)/0.75 ≈ 59-88. winH = availH ≈ 381-410 (Panels.luau:843-845). The touch chrome sets th=59 and contentTop=79 (Panels.luau:820, 829), so about 290-320 units of content are visible. The action row starts at about y=335: 4 + 170 + name ~27 + page ~18 + 2-line text ~50 + status ~16 + 5×10 gaps. Its 60-high buttons are below the fold. The server auto-opens Welcome (QuestService.luau:331). Not verified in the engine.

dims.summary:
Tooling/apply-readiness review (read-only; the repo is unchanged: `git status --short` showed 225 entries at the start and after every run, and the untracked-files status was identical before and after the sandboxed tests).

Key results:
(1) HANDOFF's claim is correct. `build/gameplay_runtime.py` syncs only 8 targets and never pushes CombatService, ClassPicker, FactionPicker or Fx. Using it would leave a broken mixed state in Studio: the new HUD sends `Release` to the old CombatService, which formats the deleted `Config.Text.ReleaseNeed`.
(2) `build/GoodEvil.rbxlx` is byte-identical to `place/GoodEvil.rbxlx` (sha f0b7568c…). The place reflects only 3 of the 12 changed src files (DataService, ShopService, CameraFollow). The other 9 are not applied: Config, Net, QuestService, HUD and Panels hold an older pre-manual-combat version; CombatService, ClassPicker, FactionPicker and Fx equal HEAD. An in-memory dry run of `update_gameplay_place.prepare()` over all 12 targets succeeds: 9 change, 3 stay the same, it is idempotent, and the instance count stays at 4501.
(3) luau-compile: all 43 of 43 src files compile. I confirmed the compiler does catch syntax errors and the 200-local limit.
(4) Sandboxed offline tests all pass on current sources: onboarding 459, skill_release 245, camera 33, potions 929, blacksmith 1348.
(5) `.gitignore` covers `.env` and `build/` but not `.tripo/`. `approved.json` now points to an untracked art/out PNG. Many runners overwrite evidence in docs. Required runners and the Luau toolchain live only in the ignored `build/` folder.
(6) Evidence SHAs are partly stale. The current Config.luau matches no evidence record. HUD, Panels, ClassPicker, FactionPicker and Fx have no source-pinned evidence at all.

Rule conflicts relevant to tooling:
- TECH_SPEC §1.1 says not to run sync/playtest/build_place, while AGENTS says to use them.
- `build_place.py` would overwrite the Studio-saved `build/GoodEvil.rbxlx`.
- AGENTS still says to generate images freely with GPT/Codex. Codex was cancelled, Firefly is now the image source, and AGENTS also requires approval for paid work.
checked_ok: build/GoodEvil.rbxlx and place/GoodEvil.rbxlx are byte-identical (sha256 f0b7568cc1152fa35df0a27d33f4280025324c14b7ee5d8e2845a6657c001cfd, 12,550,601 bytes, 0 CR bytes); this equals updated_sha256 in gameplay_10min/place_update.json, and HEAD's place (28e47624…, 12,526,206 bytes) equals its recorded original_sha256. No leftover *.tmp staging files or .rbxlx.lock files.

Offline compile: build/luau_cli_0_741/luau-compile.exe compiled all 43 src/**/*.luau files with 0 failures. Verified in scratch that this compiler reports both SyntaxError and 'Out of local registers ... exceeded limit 200', so the 200-local rule is covered. Rough top-level local counts: Fx ~169, HUD ~142, Panels ~136.

Sandboxed offline tests: copies in scratch had ROOT pinned to the repo for reads and every write (harness .luau and report JSON) redirected to scratch/out, confirmed by grep. Results on current sources: test_onboarding ONBOARDING_OFFLINE_OK checks=459; test_skill_release SKILL_RELEASE_OFFLINE_OK checks=245; test_camera_input CAMERA_INPUT_SUMMARY checks=33 failed=0; test_potions POTION_OFFLINE_OK checks=929; gameplay_blacksmith_check BLACKSMITH_OFFLINE_OK checks=1348. Untracked-files status was identical before and after (329 lines), and the existing build/ and docs report mtimes were unchanged.

tools/update_gameplay_place.py lists exactly the 12 changed files. An in-memory dry run of prepare() (no main(), bytecode writing disabled, nothing written) showed 9 bodies changing, CameraFollow/ShopService/DataService unchanged, second run byte-identical, 4501 instances, all non-target bytes preserved. The 'both_sources_match_files' key it pops does exist in update_faction_place.prepare().

tools/sync_to_studio.py covers every src script: it compares CR-stripped hashes and recreates only differing scripts. In the place, no script under ServerScriptService, ReplicatedStorage or StarterPlayer is missing from src (0 extras), and no managed script has children, attributes or tags, so its delete-and-recreate approach is safe. The only script with children is ServerStorage/CostumeAnimationControllers/R15, which is outside the managed roots.
The place's own saved sources are internally consistent for the shop: the place Net includes SellWeapon, which the place ShopService (= current src) connects to.

dims.summary:
Read-only first-10-minute trace of the uncommitted working tree (HEAD 9f71510). Everything here comes from reading code and data. Nothing was run in Studio. The 10 changed Luau files compile with the offline luau-compile (exit 0).

ESTIMATED TIMELINE. Assumptions: Halo Warrior, no underdog bonus, no Release daily. The kill rate is the Config's own reference of 12 kills/min (Config.luau 669); it was not measured.

- 0:00-0:40 — Faction picker (locked FreshTyped cards). ChooseFaction respawns the player at home: Halo spawn (0,0,-410), Horns (0,0,410), Neutral (0,0,-25) (Config 724/727/730; FactionService 274-295). The +300 bank gold goes only to a player who joins the weaker side, measured over non-rookie players (Config 469; FactionService 288-293; JusticeService 286-292).
- 0:40-1:10 — Class pick. 0.5 s later the server opens the 3-page faction guide (QuestService 741-746, 329-333; Config 919-944). "함께할게요" sets step 1 (QuestService 341-346). Closing the dialog does not accept (Panels 1198-1200).
- 1:10-1:35 — Step 1. Pinned row "보급로 되찾기 · 메뉴 > 이동 > 말랑 초원" (Config 948) plus a straight beam to Pad_SlimeMeadow (52,0,-24) (Config 773; HUD 2563-2564).
  - Halo walks about 440 studs at WalkSpeed 20 (Config 12): ~22 s. Horns walks about 486 studs: ~24 s. Neutral walks 52 studs: ~3 s.
  - Alternative: Menu travel, a 3 s channel (Config 818).
- 1:35 — Arrive at meadow spawn (220,0,0) (Config 733). Step 2 toast: "첫 임무: 보급로 되찾기 · 슬라임 5마리! (보상 120골드)" (Config 949).
- 1:35-2:30 — 5 kills.
  - Slime HP 10, BigSlime HP 40 (Config 881-882).
  - Tier-1 weapon damage 8 (Config 156) × class × 0.5 per swing (Config 296): Warrior 4 dmg, 3 swings at 1.0 s; Mage 5 dmg, 2 swings at 1.25 s (3 MP each); Archer 2 dmg, 5 swings at 0.5 s, hits 2 targets. Horns gets +15%.
  - Skill: 6× damage, radius 9, MP 20, 3 s cooldown (Config 295), i.e. 48/62/26 damage.
  - Monsters: aggro 30, respawn 4 s, respawns placed 18-28 studs from a player who has few monsters nearby (Config 853-857, 876). Density 12 Slime + 4 BigSlime, +2 per extra player, capped at 2× (Config 872).
  - Kill credit is shared by everyone who hit within 15 s (MonsterService 1053-1066), so other players don't steal kills.
  - Total: about 30-60 s.
- 2:30 — Claim: +120 bank gold, 0 XP (Config 916-917; QuestService 382-391).
  - Pocket gold from 5 kills: Halo/Neutral 15, Horns 20 (ProgressionService 419). Total about 135/140 against the 150-gold wood weapon (Config 157).
  - Player is Lv2 (Lv2 needs 15 XP, Lv3 needs 54 total).
  - The claim toast sends the player to "교차로 대장간" (Config 951).
- 2:30-3:30 — Travel 3 s, then a beam to the anvil (39,1.5,45), about 80 studs. Pressing the G prompt sets BlacksmithVisited (ShopService 194-202). With 135-140 gold the shop shows the shortfall, so 3-5 more slimes are needed first.
- 3:30 — The pinned row disappears (QuestService 409-415). The HUD card is now a fixed text "장비 상인" (HUD 1908-1910).
- 3:30-10:00 — About 78 kills.
  - Average per kill: XP about 11 Halo / 8.25 others; gold about 4.75, Horns 6.25.
  - By 10:00: about Lv7-8 Halo / Lv6 Neutral, plus about 370-490 gold.
  - Lv5 (227 XP total) at about minute 5 announces the iron weapon unlock (Fx 1678-1685). Iron costs 800 (Config 158): about 14 more minutes of hunting without dailies.
  - Lv10 (1381 XP), which opens Goblin Woods (Config 735), arrives after about 11 min (Halo) / 14 min (others) of hunting.
- Dailies: 3 per day, each paying 180 gold + 300 XP below Lv10 (Config 990, 1002-1004; QuestService 223-224). A Kill daily (50-60 slimes, starts 10-20% done) finishes around minute 6-9.
- War chest: at least 30 personal points pays Lv×100 (winner) or Lv×30 (loser) at round end (Config 600-602).
- Goose: one 60 s event every 10 min (Config 629-632), Halo/Horns only.
- Variance:
  - About half of new players roll a Release daily. That gives 180 gold + 300 XP in the first minute, i.e. Lv5 and the wood weapon (first10min-release-quest-whiff).
  - An underdog joiner gets +300 gold.

GOOD/EVIL (GDD §0) IN THE FIRST 10 MINUTES:
- Faction choice.
- Faction tone in the guide dialogue.
- Passive perks: Halo skill heals allies, Horns lifesteal and gold bonus.
- Slime kills add war points to the meter (WarService 412-416). Nothing explains this.
- The goose rescue-vs-poach event is the only real choice moment.
- PvP choices (help or plunder) are blocked for rookies below Lv15 or under 1 hour of play (Config 516-517).
- Neutral is outside angel/devil entirely.

DEATH: no PvE gold loss (PvPService 426-444). Respawn after 3 s at home. Tutorial progress is saved. There is no beam back to the meadow at step 2.

POTIONS: the shop is disabled (Config 33), yet the potion buttons read "구매". Neutral has no HP regen outside towns.

PHONE: attack, skill, menu and shop card are always visible. The anvil prompt is tappable. The guide dialogue buttons are 60 px tall. All unverified on a real device.

TOP RISKS:
1. Release quests complete from skill whiffs in a safe town.
2. No next goal after the blacksmith visit.
3. The 120-gold reward sends players to the shop 10-15 gold short.
4. The docs still assume GPT/Codex image generation after the 2026-10-05 Codex cancellation, which is not yet recorded in any doc.
checked_ok: Guide mission flow matches GDD §0-2 / SPEC_ADDENDUM A22. The 3-page faction guide opens once per session after the class pick (QuestService 329-366, 741-746). RequestTutorial/AcceptTutorial require zero arguments and are rate-limited (QuestService 335-346). Closing or 'later' never accepts (Panels 1198-1200). The Menu 'meet the guide' entry exists only at step 0 (Panels 1230-1232). Kills or zone entry before acceptance never advance the step (QuestService 767-774). No personal town slime is spawned: MonsterService.SpawnPersonal has no caller.

Tutorial kill counting is correct: Slime/BigSlime only, monster ZoneId must be SlimeMeadow, personal monsters excluded, capped at 5 (QuestService 46-51, 368-380). A kill in the same tick as zone entry is handled (QuestService 769-773).

Tutorial claim cannot pay twice: the step is set to 99 before gold is added (QuestService 385-386). TutorialKills is saved in the data table via SetStat (PlayerService 614-621), defaults to 0 and is clamped on load (Config 111; DataService fillDefaults diff). Never reset on rejoin (QuestService 716).

Blacksmith is server-authoritative. It checks the exact anvil instance, distance ≤ 12, alive, class chosen, sale cap tier 3, ownership mask, price and level, and rate limit (ShopService 25-98, 140-202). Sale pays floor(price×0.1) and removes ownership before paying (ShopService 126-130). The starting weapon is equip-only. No purchase is forced; a visit alone completes the step-99 goal (ShopService 200; QuestService 409-415).

Shared kill credit: every player who hit within 15 s gets full gold/XP and tutorial credit (Config 858; MonsterService 1053-1066). Density scales +2 per extra player in the zone, capped at 2× (Config 872; MonsterService 360-365). Respawns are placed near a player with few monsters nearby (MonsterService 488-515), so meadow competition is cooperative, not kill-stealing.

First-pass combat numbers make the first hunt short with no grind wall to 5 kills. Tier-1 slime kill takes 1-2 s for every class/faction combination (Config 156, 222-256, 296). Skill 6× damage at radius 9 one-shots slimes (Config 295). Slime damage 2 per 1.5 s vs 100-156 Lv1 HP gives low death risk. The tier-2 weapon roughly halves hits per slime (meaningful upgrade).

PvE death costs no gold unless the player is a wanted Horns (PvPService 426-444). Respawn 3 s at the home zone spawn (Config 13; PlayerService 417-418). Rookie protection (below Lv15 or under 1 h playtime) keeps new players out of PvP (Config 516-517).

Manual combat is enforced server-side. Swing returns unless isManual; Release returns if isAuto. Both require ClassChosen and being alive. The skill is gated by MP 20 and a 3 s server cooldown (CombatService 602-628, 808-831). The HUD sends one Swing per press (HUD 2612-2623) and a short click via CameraFollow.PrimaryClick (HUD 3075).

The level-up announcement now lists only real unlocks: shop weapons up to tier 3, zones, rebirth (Fx 1658-1688). The Lv5 auto-attack unlock is gone from the client. Zone guide beams at Lv10/Lv25 (HUD 2572-2590).
Offline luau-compile exit 0 for Config, QuestService, ShopService, CombatService, DataService, HUD, Panels, ClassPicker, Fx, CameraFollow (working tree).

User problem 6/6 (first-screen appeal / card height mismatch): not addressed. Approved FreshTyped cards stay locked; alignment still pending.

findings.title: Skill-use quests (incl. 180g+300XP dailies) complete by whiffing the skill in a safe town

findings.explanation: CombatService.Release spends MP and fires Released even when MonstersHit and PlayersHit are 0. attackBlocked only checks zone MinLevel, and towns are MinLevel 1. QuestService.onReleased counts any non-auto release. A Release daily needs 3 uses and pays HuntValue(level,5): 180 gold + 300 XP below Lv10 (60 slime kills' worth). When skill quests needed charge stacks, 3 uses implied combat; after A22 removed charge they need nothing. Rerolls keep the Daily kind and have a 60 s cooldown, so a player can fish all 3 dailies into Release and add the chest (+360g/+600XP) without ever fighting.
findings.failure_scenario: A new Halo player gets a '스킬 3번 사용하기' daily (Release has weight 20 of 100, so roughly half of players see one among 3 dailies). Still in HaloTown, before talking to the guide, they press Q three times (60 of 100 MP), then claim. Result: +180 bank gold and +300 XP, so Lv1→Lv5, and the wood weapon is affordable. The hunt → loot → growth loop of the first 10 minutes is skipped. Rerolling the other dailies into Release gives about 900 gold and Lv10 within roughly 15 min of standing in town.
findings.suggested_fix: One-line server fix in QuestService.onReleased: return unless (tonumber(info.MonstersHit) or 0) > 0. Released already carries MonstersHit (CombatService 968). Ask the user whether GDD §8 / A22 wording ('서버가 인정한 사용 횟수') should read 'a skill that hit a monster'. Re-verify the Release daily and extras in engine.
findings.verifier_note: The behavior is real. CombatService.Release (808-971) has no town or hit check and fires Released with MonstersHit=0. QuestService.onReleased (783-787) counts every release that is not auto. A daily pays HuntValue(lv,5) = 180g/300XP, enough for Lv1->Lv5 (227 XP needed). Correction: this matches the written contract. SPEC_ADDENDUM.md:10 says 'Release 퀘스트는 서버가 인정한 수동 스킬 사용 횟수로 진행' and GDD.md:304 says the same, so fixing it needs a spec/user change, not only a code fix. Second correction: newQuest (QuestService 196-205) avoids duplicate templates, so 3 Release dailies cannot exist at once. They can only be fished one after another (claim, then reroll another daily after the 60s cooldown). Severity raised because Release Extras are also auto-paid and refill immediately (QuestService 504-508), which makes town farming unbounded (see missed).

findings.explanation:
Step by step, based only on the tool descriptions read with ToolSearch:
(1) GENERATE: no text-to-image tool is listed. image_select_subject and image_select_by_prompt both say "inform them that generative editing is not currently available". asset_preview_file names an 'image_generate' tool, but it is not in this session's tool list. So the user generates manually in the Firefly web app.
(2) RETRIEVE: asset_search with entityScope 'GenAIAsset' ("find my Firefly generations") plus asset_inline_preview lets the model see the user's Firefly results. No download tool is listed (asset_inline_preview mentions 'download_firefly_generation', which is not available). Whether the rendition URL is the full-resolution original for Firefly generation assets is unclear: asset_preview_file guarantees the original only for native png/jpeg.
(3) SHOW ONE BY ONE: asset_preview_file, or create_firefly_board / boards_add_items_to_board (1-12 images, import_generation_ids for Firefly results). A board shows many images at once, so show one image per preview to keep the one-by-one rule. Local files can be shown with SendUserFile.
(4) APPROVE: the user answers in chat and the worker records it in art/approved.json. No Adobe step.
(5) CUTOUT: image_remove_background returns a transparent PNG of the 'main subject'. If the input exceeds the API limit, it is downscaled automatically and stays smaller (reported in a 'tradeoffs' entry). Multi-piece UI parts or frames with inner holes may need checking. image_select_* plus image_invert_selection can make refinement masks.
(6) LIGHT/DARK ENLARGED CHECK: done locally with PIL (current practice). No Adobe tool is needed.
(7) UPLOAD ≤10 TO ROBLOX: tools/upload_ui_assets.py with the Studio MCP upload_image. Not Adobe.
Also: getting local repo PNGs into Adobe needs either asset_add_file (a file picker the user operates) or asset_initialize_file_upload, whose description says not to use it for the user's local files. Per the server instructions, every Adobe tool must be preceded by adobe_mandatory_init.

1. The agent writes the prompt.
2. The user generates in Firefly web and saves each image to art/out/<id>.png, or the agent finds it with asset_search(GenAIAsset).
3. The agent shows the candidates one by one.
4. The user picks.
5. Cutout with image_remove_background or locally; record the downscale tradeoff and keep the original.
6. Local PIL enlarged checks on light and dark backgrounds.
7. Upload ≤10 via upload_ui_assets.py.
Open questions for the user: (a) Will you generate in Firefly yourself, or should the agent wait for an Adobe generation tool? (b) May the agent upload repo PNGs to your Adobe Creative Cloud for background removal? (c) Can Firefly results be downloaded at full resolution to art/out?

findings.title: 'Transparent PNGs from the start' may be impossible with Firefly, and prep_ui.py silently accepts images with no transparency

findings.explanation: 232 of the 304 prompt files ask for a transparent background, and 167 rely on 'attached' reference images (counted with grep). The only Adobe path to transparency in this session is image_remove_background, which works on the 'main subject' and may downscale. prep_ui.py converts any input to RGBA. A fully opaque image gets a full-frame bounding box, so the output is the whole opaque rectangle, with no warning. tools/upload_ui_assets.py checks only the PNG signature and the SHA, not transparency. Keep the original and apply the Cutout-quality rule."
